During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] operated a '''military base''' on a [[Unidentified Ando system planetoid|planetoid]] in the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the base was [[Mission to the Ando system|attacked]] and captured by [[Strike Force Cularin]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]].
